title: Pointwise bound by the product supremum norm
statement: Let $\\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set and let $n$ be a natural number. For any real-valued function $f$ on $\\Omega^n$ and any $x\\in\\Omega^n$, $|f(x)|$ is at most the supremum of $|f|$ over $\\Omega^n$.
